content.text:
BITS_OMS_Complete_Feature_Showcase_15s — Cinematic 15-second B2B SaaS commercial, 16:9 widescreen, premium 2K, for Boundless IT Solutions (BITS) Operations Management System (OMS). Style reference: fast-paced monday.com / GoDaddy pacing, high-altitude 3D volumetric cloud atmospheres, tactile frosted glassmorphism UI, premium B2B commercial.

BRAND:
- Company: Boundless IT Solutions (BITS)
- Product: BITS Operations Management System (BITS OMS) — all-in-one contact center and collections operations
- Logo: BITS wordmark with the Infinity-B-in-cloud emblem (REFERENCED). Strict "B"-height clearspace on all four sides, no rotation/skew/drop-shadow/neon glow
- Brand colors: #124294 Royal Azure (foundation), #E0F2FE Stratosphere Vapor (translucent frosted glass), #F8FAFC Cirrus Cloud White (app canvas), #2563EB Electric Blue (live indicators), #38BDF8 Sky Cyan (infinity glow), #F59E0B Horizon Sunrise Amber (critical metrics only), #FFFFFF Pure Cloud White (high-contrast typography)
- Typography: Outfit (Bold for headlines, Semi-Bold for feature callouts, Medium for body)

ATMOSPHERE (REFERENCED from hero-landscape image):
Soft alpine valley at first light, cool slate-blue and misted navy mountain ranges on the left/right/far background, pale empty wash of fog and sky in the center where the dashboard will sit. Calm, expensive, airy. Premium B2B SaaS mood.

VOICEOVER (off-screen, calm mid-pitch measured Manila cadence, female voice S1):
- Shot 1 (0:00-0:03): "Tired of fragmented software slowing down your operations?"
- Shot 2 (0:03-0:07): "Meet the complete BITS OMS — unifying your CRM, auto-dialer, and QA scorecards in one cockpit."
- Shot 3 (0:07-0:11): "Seamlessly connected to your mobile field team with real-time sync and zero per-seat fees."
- Shot 4 (0:11-0:15): "Scale your operations without the ceiling. Visit boundlessits.com today."

STORYBOARD:

[Shot 1, 0:00-0:03] HOOK & UNIFIED COCOCKPIT
- Cinematic deep Royal Azure environment framed by soft 3D volumetric clouds in slow parallax
- A small frosted-glass badge slides in: "BITS OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM" in Sky Cyan Outfit Bold
- Headline fades in: "ONE SYSTEM. ONE VIEW. ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH." in Pure White Outfit Bold
- A young professional mid-30s Filipino female account executive (S1) appears in a 2-second mid-shot — shoulder-length dark hair, navy blazer over white tee — asking the hook question, then closes her lips into a confident smile
- Three translucent frosted-glass panels glide into view and snap together into a unified cockpit layout
- Camera: 3D dolly-in with small amplitude at slow speed

[Shot 2, 0:03-0:07] IN-OFFICE OMS: CRM, DIALER & TELEMETRY
- Ultra-HD screen view of the BITS OMS cockpit
- Left panel: Customer 360 Dossier card in Cirrus Cloud White
- Center panel: WebRTC softphone dialer in mid-call with live transcript feed
- Right panel: QA Scorecards card
- Recovery Velocity KPI hero card on the right: "RIGHT-PARTY CONNECT: +3.2x" in Horizon Sunrise Amber with a Sky Cyan trajectory graph
- Three feature callouts float: "Customer 360 Dossiers", "WebRTC Softphone Dialer", "Automated QA Scorecards"
- Camera: smooth 45-degree isometric sweep at slow speed

[Shot 3, 0:07-0:11] FIELD COLLECTIONS MOBILE APP & LIVE SYNC
- A frosted-glass mobile device mockup slides out from the desktop interface
- Mobile screen shows a paginated list of assigned debtor accounts with a pinned geolocation map at the top
- On the right, out-of-focus: a young Filipino male field agent in a BITS polo, walking on a Manila side street, eyes on his phone
- Sky Cyan sync-pulse animation travels between mobile and desktop
- Three feature callouts: "Mobile Field Collector App", "Instant Geo & PTP Sync", "Zero Per-User Traps"
- Camera: split-focus pan at medium amplitude at slow speed

[Shot 4, 0:11-0:15] PREMIUM BRAND OUTRO & CTA
- UI cards dissolve into a deep solid Royal Azure stage with subtle ambient cloud vapor
- The official BITS logo (REFERENCED) anchors dead-center, respecting the mandatory "B"-height clearspace exclusion zone
- Below the logo, centered and outside the clearspace box, three lines fade in sequentially:
  - "Stay Grounded, Be Boundless." (Outfit Medium, Pure White)
  - "https://www.boundlessits.com/" (Outfit Medium, Pure White)
  - "boundlessitsolutions@gmail.com" (Outfit Medium, Pure White)
- Camera: dead-still focal lock for the full 4-second hold

SOUNDSCAPE:
- Quiet premium room tone throughout
- Soft whoosh of cloud drift in shot 1
- Soft keyboard taps and a faint pulse on the live-call timer in shot 2
- Soft Manila street ambience in the background of shot 3, with a clean ping on the sync-pulse animation
- Soft ambient cloud drift in shot 4

NON-DIEGETIC MUSIC:
- Clean modern mid-tempo tech-strings pattern with a single sustained low cello
- Sky Cyan-mirrored soft synth pad landing on the start of every shot
- Gentle swell through shots 2 and 3, holds on shot 4
- Fades to silence two beats after the final logo card
- No vocals, no drop, no hard cut

VISUAL REFERENCE LABELS (for H3 to track consistently):
- <Subject 1> = the young professional mid-30s Filipino female account executive (S1) who delivers the entire voiceover, calm mid-pitch measured Manila cadence
- <Subject 2> = the BITS OMS desktop cockpit interface (Customer 360, WebRTC dialer, QA Scorecards, Recovery Velocity KPI)
- <Subject 3> = the BITS Field Collections mobile app mockup (frosted-glass Android phone, geolocation map, two-way sync indicators)
- <Subject 4> = the field agent (young Filipino male, BITS polo, smartphone, walking on Manila side street)
- <Picture 1> = the BITS primary horizontal logo (the wordmark with Infinity-B-in-cloud)
- <Picture 2> = the wide hero-landscape image (alpine valley first light, cool slate-blue atmosphere)
- <Picture 3> = the BITS Infinity-B mark in cloud emblem

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- All text rendered in Outfit font with crisp anti-aliasing
- Logo respects mandatory "B"-height clearspace, no rotation/skew/drop-shadow/neon glow
- Horizon Sunrise Amber used ONLY for critical metrics (not generic accents)
- Total duration EXACTLY 15 seconds
- Cut times: shot 2 starts at 00:03.000, shot 3 at 00:07.000, shot 4 at 00:11.500
